summary.zh-Hans: 维多利亚州立图书馆的拉筹伯阅览室呈八角形，穹顶下的书桌向外放射排列，配有绿色玻璃灯罩。
summary.en: State Library Victoria’s octagonal La Trobe Reading Room has radiating desks beneath a dome, with green glass lamp shades.

names.zh-Hans: 皇家展览馆与卡尔顿花园
names.en: Royal Exhibition Building and Carlton Gardens

summary.zh-Hans: 墨尔本皇家展览馆与周围的卡尔顿花园共同构成世界遗产。花园布局包括林荫小径、喷泉和湖泊。
summary.en: Melbourne’s Royal Exhibition Building and surrounding Carlton Gardens form a World Heritage property. The gardens include tree-lined paths, fountains and lakes.

summary.zh-Hans: 墨尔本的 dim sim 是咸味肉馅点心，有蒸制和油炸的做法。
summary.en: Melbourne’s dim sims are savoury meat-filled parcels served steamed or fried.

summary.zh-Hans: 墨尔本维多利亚女王市场的果酱甜甜圈是炸制点心，内有果酱，外面撒糖。
summary.en: Jam doughnuts at Melbourne’s Queen Victoria Market are fried, filled with jam and dusted with sugar.
